Manufacturers of blood and blood components are subject to 21 CFR Part 820 [1]. The requirement applies to devices that support or sustain life, including blood and blood components, as specified in the provisions of this part. [1]  

If applicable, the requirements in 21 CFR 820.10 apply to class II, class III, and those class I devices listed in paragraph (c)(1) of this section and table 1 to paragraph (c)(2) of this section [1].  

As appropriate, the requirements in 21 CFR 820.10 also apply to devices that are regulated as implantable medical devices, as specified in the provisions of this part. [1]  

Where applicable, the requirements in 21 CFR 820.35 apply to the control of records, including complaints and servicing activities. [1]  

The requirements in 21 CFR 820.3 also apply to the control of records, including unique device identification. [1]  

The requirements in 21 CFR 820.45 apply to the labeling and packaging controls, including ensuring accuracy and documentation. [1]
rows.final_answer:
Manufacturers of blood and blood components are subject to 21 CFR Part 820 [1]. The requirement applies to devices that support or sustain life, including blood and blood components, as specified in the provisions of this part [1]. 

If applicable, the requirements in 21 CFR 820.10 apply to class II, class III, and those class I devices listed in paragraph (c)(1) of this section and table 1 to paragraph (c)(2) of this section [1]. 

As appropriate, the requirements in 21 CFR 820.10 also apply to devices that are regulated as implantable medical devices, as specified in the provisions of this part [1].
